name: cannabis-2026
description: Cannabis sativa biopesticide study IJMS2026,8000: source cohort audit, six-target docking comparisons, train-only AppendixA RMT selection, RTE CatBoost/linear-SVM validation, genuine Chemprop DMPNN paired random/scaffold validation on available3171labels, public-data toxicity benchmarks/profiles and applicability. Exact final cohort/author-weight replay is unavailable; published references and new computations are distinguished. Computes paired RTE/DMPNN fusion and candidate ranking with explicit unknown secondary-metabolite annotations; all nine open toxicity endpoints are available. The same toxicity-profile tool offers recipe=nested_paper2024_v2 for completed independently replayed nested-tuning models with applied 2024 preparation; explicitly requested endpoints without completed runs are reported unavailable. The default fixed_public_v1 remains a distinct approximation.

name: heracleum-2026
description: Heracleum furanocoumarins IJMS 2026 7947: scaffold chemistry, docking and ADMETlab PCA, scaffold KS separability, random/scaffold surrogate validation, identity-aware candidate tiers and published pose-recovery table analysis. Not the older Plants LD50 study. CV defaults to strict identities; exact published-snapshot replay must be explicitly requested. Returns numerical CSV tables and regenerated figures. Dataset audit distinguishes parsable source graphs from18all-zero archived docking profiles; no geometry or InChI validation is inferred. Existing docking validation also supports a separately labeled public-crystal reconstruction: actual poses, fixed-frame RMSD, explicit receptor-preparation failures and downloadable structures; default remains published Table S1a analysis.

name: mannich-2026
description: Scientific Data asymmetric organocatalytic Mannich dataset: curated reaction/catalyst identity, axial stereochemistry audit, ee-to-ddG conversion, conditions, SMARTS classes, scaffolds, t-SNE, selectivity heatmaps, representative/scaffold vector structure pages, SDF audit and declared reaction PCA reconstruction. OCR is manual and not implemented. Regenerates all curated catalyst SDFs under the original algorithm and a separately labeled geometry/CIP-checked alternative, preserving failed or conditional cases.
